title: Sharp Weak-Trace Regularity of Stochastic Cross Integrals
summary: We prove a sharp spatial regularity theorem for the Itô and Stratonovich cross integrals of continuous semimartingales in separable Hilbert spaces. Without global moment assumptions, both integrals admit versions that are almost surely jointly continuous in the two time variables, with values in the little weak-trace ideal. This regularity is optimal even for Wiener processes with deterministic trace-one covariance.
